changelog:
⚡ What's New & Fixed in v1.7.9:

• 🛡️ Complete Immunity to TV & Ambient Audio: Standby wake listening now requires finalized Viterbi endpointing and RMS energy gating (>= 0.018f), completely ignoring quiet background TV murmurs and partial fluctuations.

• 🎯 Strict 5 Wake-Words Only: Absolutely zero loose phonetic matching ('javis', 'jervis', etc. removed). Added broad common-word distractor vocabulary to Vosk so TV speech is recognized as ordinary words rather than falsely forced into wake phrases.

• 🔒 Background Voice Playback Guard: JARVIS is strictly prevented from playing speech aloud in the background unless the turn contains an explicit verified wake word or is within an active 10s command window.

• ⏱️ Tight 12s Background Timeout: Standby mode returns automatically after 12s of inactivity without being perpetually extended by background TV noise.
